messages:
customer_acme_oncall: Hey — console for org `acme-prod` shows a $150 trial credit balance but our API invoices show normal charges. We just got billed for a call at 00:03 UTC. Can someone check?

alex_support: Thanks for the ping. Can you paste the org id and one example request id / timestamp where you saw the charge?

customer_acme_oncall: org: org_0A1B2C3D, example request id: req_20260315_0003, time ~ 2026-03-15T00:03:12Z. Using key from env VAR: ACME_SK.

morgan_support: @customer_acme_oncall confirming — console UI screenshot would help too (we just need the top-right credit widget). Also, are you using multiple projects/sub-accounts under that org? Sometimes credits attach to a different billing profile.

customer_acme_oncall: attaching screenshot: https://imgur.example/snap.png — shows 150 USD trial. We do have two billing profiles: `acme-main` and `acme-dev` (dev is where infra team runs experiments). API calls are from service account tied to `acme-main` though.

alex_support: Thanks. I'm going to triage with billing — looping in @chris_billing.

chris_billing: digging in. Looking up org_0A1B2C3D… I see a promo grant record: promo_20260301_trial -> amount 150.00 USD status=applied to billing_profile bp_89X_main at 2026-03-01T12:00Z. The API usage for req_20260315_0003 shows billing_profile bp_77Y_dev. So the promo was attached to main but the call was billed to dev. That explains the console vs API mismatch. :eyes:

customer_acme_oncall: How would calls be billed to dev profile? We thought the service key is for main.

raj_engineer: quick check — sometimes keys are issued at the project level and inherit a different billing profile. Can you run `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/account` and paste the returned `billing_profile_id` field (redact key)? That will confirm what profile the key maps to.

customer_acme_oncall: ran it and got: `{"org_id":"org_0A1B2C3D","billing_profile_id":"bp_77Y_dev","project":"svc-notebooks"}`. Oops — that's the issue.

morgan_support: Okay — two potential fixes: 1) Move promo credit from bp_89X_main -> bp_77Y_dev (fast for us), or 2) reissue a key scoped to main profile (customer action). Which do you prefer?

customer_acme_oncall: Prefer we keep prod on main and move dev credits to dev — but for now could you move some trial credits to the billing profile being used to avoid immediate charges?

chris_billing: I can reallocate 100 USD of the trial balance to bp_77Y_dev as a short-term mitigation. I'll record the journal entry and note. Doing now.

billing-bot: [audit] promo_move id=pm_5542 from=bp_89X_main to=bp_77Y_dev amount=100.00 status=completed by=chris_billing ts=2026-03-15T01:05:12Z

chris_billing: Done — please retry the failing call after ~2 minutes (credit ledger sync). If you still see charges, reply and we'll refund the specific invoice.

customer_acme_oncall: retrying now… the subsequent request shows 0.00 on the usage line. Thank you! :tada:

alex_support: Great — I'll keep this thread open until billing confirms reconciliation. Logged internal incident INC-9876 for tracking (billing reconciliation for org_0A1B2C3D).

raj_engineer: follow-up item for infra: we should add a small quick-check script in the console that warns when a key's billing_profile_id != org default billing_profile to avoid surprise charges. Filing ENG-4321.

chris_billing: Reconciliation note: invoice inv_20260315 for req_20260315_0003 will be credited for 100 USD; remaining 50 USD of trial still sits on bp_89X_main. Customer will get full breakdown via email.

customer_acme_oncall: appreciate the quick help, team. Would like a short writeup on root cause so we can avoid this.

alex_support: Will DM you a short RCA and post a one-paragraph blurb in the billing FAQ. Closing here after confirmation email lands. :white_check_mark:
